title: Add runtime supervisor and heartbeat foundation
summary: Added runtime supervisor with heartbeat and supervisor lock foundation. Correction pass 3 fixes the final PM-identified defect: signal-triggered shutdown path now calls detachSignalHandlers() after shutdown actions, preventing stale owned listeners from remaining in a host process. Adds in-process signal handler test that triggers the actual registered SIGTERM handler and proves listener cleanup, lock release, SHUTDOWN heartbeat, and fresh instance restart.

correctionDetails.defect1: handleSignal() did not call detachSignalHandlers() after shutdown — fixed by adding detachSignalHandlers() call after releaseSupervisorLock and onShutdown callback
correctionDetails.defect2: Missing in-process test that triggers actual signal handler and proves cleanup — added in-process SIGTERM handler test via process.listeners() invocation

validation.jsonParseChecks: PASS (handover JSON, state JSON all valid)

supervisorBehavior.atomicWrite: Write to .tmp then rename to final path
supervisorBehavior.sigtermHandling: Graceful shutdown with final heartbeat, lock release, AND signal handler detachment
supervisorBehavior.sigintHandling: Graceful shutdown with final heartbeat, lock release, AND signal handler detachment
supervisorBehavior.noSecretsInHeartbeat: Verified — no env vars, tokens, or secrets in heartbeat
supervisorBehavior.lifecycle: Single-use — start() returns SINGLE_USE on second call. Create fresh instance via createSupervisor() to restart. Signal handlers properly detached on both stop() and signal-triggered shutdown.

tests.heartbeatWrite: Verified atomic write with temp file pattern
tests.heartbeatRead: Returns null for missing file, parsed object for valid file
tests.supervisorLock: Acquire, inspect, release with PID/hostname/role tracking
tests.supervisorLifecycle: Start, stop, setStatus, single-use enforcement, signal handler lifecycle
tests.cliBoundary: 4 CLI tests including dry-run JSON, mode/interval flags, live start/SIGTERM
tests.realSubprocessSignals: 2 tests: SIGTERM and SIGINT with isolated temp dirs verifying heartbeat creation, lastResult=SHUTDOWN, lock release
tests.signalHandlerCleanup: 4 tests: listener count before/after stop, fresh instance after stop, full lifecycle, in-process SIGTERM handler invocation with full proof (listener counts, lock, heartbeat, fresh instance)
tests.noSecrets: Heartbeat never records GH_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, PATH, etc.

risks: Supervisor is not yet integrated into poller/worker startup by default
Supervisor lock is separate from task claim lock and not lifecycle-managed by worker scripts
Downstream monitoring or auto-recovery from stale heartbeats is not yet wired up
nextRecommendedTask: EAI-TASK-041: Integrate runtime supervisor into poller/worker startup and wire heartbeat status into CLI output
